verdict.rationale: PayPal provides building blocks for automation—recurring Subscriptions billing, Payouts for bulk sends, Webhooks for event-driven triggers—and an Agent Toolkit plus official MCP server that let AI agents call PayPal APIs via function calling, enabling agent-driven workflows. However, none of this is presented as a first-party 'set up an autonomous background automation' feature within PayPal itself; it's developer/agent infrastructure that requires external orchestration to run autonomously. Missing for 10: a native scheduler/automation dashboard for non-developers, evidence of agents running truly unattended background tasks, and independent confirmation of the MCP/agent toolkit working end-to-end in production.
